items.title: What Does Alphabet (GOOGL) Face In This New AI Safety Lawsuit?
items.summary: Alphabet (NasdaqGS:GOOGL) unit Google DeepMind has been named in a new class-action lawsuit targeting leading AI labs. The complaint challenges an industry-funded safety oversight body that would coordinate pre-release reviews of advanced AI models. Plaintiffs allege the joint safety structure could amount to coordinated action to slow AI development and distort competition.
